evals.contract_scenario: Structural updates restore child-to-parent state prerequisites
evals.name: restore-child-background-mapping
evals.prompt: Focused remap check: using deps/platform-adoption-kernel.json, write practices/child-background-eval/result.json from this incomplete draft: {"kind":"practice","name":"Child Background Eval","baselinePracticeName":"Platform Adoption Essentials","alphas":[{"name":"Platform Onboarding","contributesTo":"Platform Consumption Interface","states":[{"name":"Piloted","seq":1},{"name":"Standardised","seq":2},{"name":"Self Served","seq":3}]}]}. Repair the alpha mapping only; no research is needed.
evals.expected_output: The remapped practice redeclares the target alpha, retains all of its original states and prerequisites, and adds parent Background references for every child state.
assertions: The target alpha appears in the practice
Each child state appears in a parent Background alphaStates reference

evals.name: preserve-stage-outcome
evals.contract_scenario: Preserve orchestration outcomes during an update
evals.prompt: Focused update check: write only practices/objective-eval/result.json. Do not run the full update pipeline. Use update-method's outcome guidance if available. Start from this practice and change only the outcome description to 'Completed review': {"kind":"practice","name":"Example","patterns":[],"outcomes":[{"name":"Completed","description":"Old description","measureDescription":"Review completion","objectiveContributions":[{"orchestrationName":"Delivery","recognizedAtStage":{"patternName":"Review","relativeTo":{"orchestrationName":"Plan"}},"stageForecastWeights":[{"stage":{"patternName":"Review","relativeTo":{"orchestrationName":"Plan"}},"weight":1.0}]}]}]}. Preserve all other fields exactly. No research or additional elements are needed.
evals.expected_output: The new description is applied while orchestrationName, hosted composite stage references and stageForecastWeights remain unchanged; no pattern is invented.
assertions: Only the requested outcome description changes
The orchestration contribution and relativeTo host survive without an invented pattern
